title: OIS Document Payload Schema
description: Standard schema for exchanging data and security permissions of enterprise files.

id.description: Unique identifier of the document in the target index.

type.description: Repository type (e.g. sharepoint, s3, database, filesystem, cmis, bpmn2).

instance.description: Base URI of the scanned repository instance.

connectorVersion.description: Version of the repository connector used.

mimeType.description: RFC 2046 media type of the document.

text.description: Extracted text content from the document (utf-8).

claimCheckUri.description: URI reference pointing to the raw binary file in shared storage.

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata map extracted from the source file, including standard CMIS repository properties and BPMN 2.0 workflow engine execution states.

cmis:objectId.description: The unique identifier of the object in the CMIS repository.

cmis:name.description: The name of the object in the CMIS repository.

cmis:objectTypeId.description: The type of the CMIS object (e.g. cmis:document, cmis:folder).

cmis:createdBy.description: The user who created the CMIS object.

cmis:creationDate.description: The timestamp when the CMIS object was created.

cmis:lastModifiedBy.description: The user who last modified the CMIS object.

cmis:changeToken.description: The change token of the CMIS object.

cmis:versionLabel.description: The version label of the CMIS document.

cmis:isLatestVersion.description: Indicates whether this is the latest version of the CMIS document.

bpmn:processInstanceId.description: The unique identifier of the workflow process instance.

bpmn:processDefinitionId.description: The unique identifier of the BPMN 2.0 process definition.

bpmn:processDefinitionKey.description: The business key/identifier of the BPMN 2.0 process definition.

bpmn:processDefinitionName.description: The human-readable name of the BPMN 2.0 process definition.

bpmn:businessKey.description: The business key associated with the process instance.

bpmn:status.description: The execution status of the workflow instance.

bpmn:startDate.description: The timestamp when the process instance was started.

bpmn:endDate.description: The timestamp when the process instance completed or terminated.

bpmn:startUserId.description: The identifier of the user who initiated the process instance.

bpmn:activeTasks.description: List of active user tasks or activities in the process instance.

taskId.description: The unique identifier of the active task instance.

taskName.description: The human-readable name of the active task.

taskDefinitionKey.description: The activity ID/key of the task in the BPMN XML.

assignee.description: The user currently assigned to the task.

candidateUsers.description: Users who are candidates to claim/perform the task.

candidateGroups.description: User groups who are candidates to claim/perform the task.

createTime.description: The timestamp when the task was created.

inheritanceEnabled.description: Indicates whether the document inherits ACL settings from its folder structure.

identity.description: Unique identifier of the user or group (e.g. Active Directory SID or email).

identityType.description: Authentication namespace/type of the identity (e.g. windows-sid, oauth-group, user-principal-name, local-role, public, cmis-user, cmis-group, bpmn-assignee, bpmn-candidate-user, bpmn-candidate-group, or custom provider namespaces).

displayName.description: Human-readable label for debugging audit logs.

access.description: Permission rule matching the security constraint.
